name: Messaging channels
description: Shared inbox with WhatsApp Cloud API and e-mail (IMAP/SMTP), with conversations on the contact timeline

create_unknown_contacts.label: Create a contact for unknown senders
create_unknown_contacts.help: On: messages from phones or e-mails without a contact create the contact. Off: the conversation stays unlinked until someone links it.

acting_user_email.label: Acting user
acting_user_email.help: E-mail of the user on whose behalf webhooks and mailbox reading look up and create contacts, when the channel does not set one. Empty: whoever created the channel.

messageTypes.too_large: E-mail too large (over 10 MB); see it in the mailbox

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.description: Team WhatsApp and e-mail conversations. Assign, reply and link them to the contact or deal.
inbox.search: Search by name, phone, e-mail or text
inbox.emptyDescription: Messages arriving on an active channel show up here.
inbox.selectDescription: Select a conversation in the list to read and reply.
inbox.noAccessDescription: Ask an administrator for the permission to see conversations.

links.title: Link conversation
links.description: Pick the contact and deal of this conversation. New messages show up on the timeline of the linked records.

composer.readOnly: You can read this conversation but cannot reply.
composer.channelInactive: The channel of this conversation is inactive; activate it to reply.
composer.label: Reply

errors.whatsapp_window_closed: More than 24 hours passed since the customer's last message. WhatsApp only accepts approved template messages until the customer writes again.
errors.messaging_invalid_reply: Write a message within the channel size limit.
errors.messaging_invalid_assignee: This user has no access to the inbox.
errors.messaging_record_not_accessible: The record does not exist or you cannot read it.
errors.messaging_channel_in_use: The channel has conversations. Deactivate it to keep the history.
errors.messaging_channel_limit_reached: The organization reached the limit of 50 channels.
errors.messaging_acting_user_unavailable: No active member can act for this channel; set the acting user.
errors.messaging_provider_timeout: The provider did not answer in time.
errors.messaging_provider_unreachable: Could not connect to the provider.
errors.messaging_tls_error: The secure (TLS) connection to the server failed.
errors.imap_auth_failed: The IMAP server rejected the user name or password.
errors.imap_error: The IMAP server returned an error.
errors.smtp_auth_failed: The SMTP server rejected the user name or password.
errors.smtp_rejected: The SMTP server rejected the message.
errors.smtp_error: The SMTP server could not take the message now.

channels.title: Messaging channels
channels.description: Connect WhatsApp numbers (Meta's official Cloud API) and mailboxes (IMAP/SMTP). Credentials are encrypted and never shown back.
channels.emptyDescription: Connect a WhatsApp number or a mailbox to receive messages.

confirmDelete.title: Delete channel?
confirmDelete.description: The channel "{{name}}" and its credentials will be removed. Only channels without conversations can be deleted.

channels.webhookUrl: Callback URL (webhook) to set at Meta
channels.verifyTokenConfigured: Verify token configured: use the same value in Meta's "Verify token" field.
channels.noAccessDescription: Ask an administrator for the permission to manage messaging channels.

help.whatsapp: Use the app data from Meta for Developers (WhatsApp > API Setup). After saving, set the webhook URL and verify token at Meta and subscribe to the "messages" field.
help.email: Enter the IMAP (receive) and SMTP (send) servers. The mailbox is read every 2 minutes, INBOX only, starting with messages that arrive after connecting.

editor.name: Channel name
editor.actingUserHint: On whose behalf incoming messages look up and create contacts. Empty: module setting or whoever created the channel.

hints.phone_number_id: Numeric id of the number, not the phone itself.
hints.access_token: Permanent token of a system user with the whatsapp_business_messaging permission.
hints.app_secret: App secret (Settings > Basic), used to validate the webhook signature.
hints.verify_token: A random text you also enter at Meta when setting the webhook.

editor.credentialsHelp: Encrypted on the server and never sent back. Leave empty to keep the current value.
editor.secretConfigured: Configured. Fill in only to replace it.
editor.reuseImapPassword: Remove the SMTP password and use the IMAP password

description.contact: WhatsApp and e-mail conversations with this contact.

timeline.failed: Failed to send a message to {{peer}} on {{channel}}
